name: Falcon Heavy | NROL-97
description: Classified payload for the US National Reconnaissance Office.
weather: Cumulus Cloud Rule, Thick Cloud Layers Rule

landing.description: The Falcon Heavy side booster B1072 will land back at the launch site at Landing Zone 2 after its 4th flight.
The Falcon Heavy side booster B1104 will land back at the launch site at Landing Zone 1 after its 2nd flight.
The Falcon Heavy center core B1106 will be expended.
